title: Toxicity in CHATGPT: Analyzing Persona-assigned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific genders (e.g., male, female, non-binary) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific races (e.g., Caucasian, African, Asian, Native American) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.

Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific sexual orientations (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual, pansexual, asexual) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.

Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific countries and region-specific names, then comparing the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API to identify regional and colonial-related prejudices.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific religions (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific age groups (e.g., kids, elders) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific professions (e.g., doctor, software developer, accountant) and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about specific political organizations and types of governments, and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
Prompting persona-assigned ChatGPT to generate text about different castes and evaluating the toxicity of the outputs using Perspective API.
